summary: Under OWNER-CHALLENGE-DESIGN-01 and the owner's grant of 2026-10-02 (RunPod, public pools only, USD 25 cap), the cold plate's and motor's public TRAIN and PRACTICE cases were solved natively on RunPod CPU pods: 308 cold plate and 149 motor cases, all OK, in about 1.5 hours. The batch runners gain a native mode (same pinned commands, own process group, killed whole on timeout); each pod is the pinned image (OpenFOAM's, or the motor's base with its Dockerfile's SHA-256-checked steps replayed); native agrees with the container (motor bitwise, cold plate 1.7e-13 K). Private plans are refused twice and never leave the owner's host. assemble.py builds each pool from every run that solved it and refuses disagreeing duplicates: cold plate TRAIN 400 and PRACTICE 100, motor TRAIN 150 and PRACTICE 30, none missing. The campaign ledger stays local (it records account balances). Pod wall times are provenance, not reference timings. No qualification, reward or LIVE authority.
